title: Warchief's Response
wikitext:
'''Warchief's Response''' is provided for {{questlong|Horde|52|Of New and Old III}}.

==As a quest objective==
* {{questlong|Horde|52|Of New and Old III}}

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
To Warleader Karfang,

I have read your letter, and have listened.

The Horde is not stranger to hardships, and adversity. All of us have had to struggle and make hard decisions as you have. We are a band of equals who share values of wisdom and honor to the wartorn and battered of this world.

If you truly wish to prove your loyalties to me as Warchief, then I require something from you.

The Twilight Hammer have begun to show themselves in your region, they are a threat to this world. Remove them for me, and I will know your word is true.

THRALL, WARCHIEF OF THE HORDE
}}

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.16.1|note=Added.}}
